QF.id: AIFM CII Investment Process and Governance_13

question.text: The PDF states that an IDEAL option pool for an Indian start-up at the time of raising its initial VC round should typically be in what range?

explanation.text: The Logic: The chapter states that an ideal option pool for a start-up in India should be between 5% to 10% of capital. The workbook uses 15% as an extreme example to illustrate how an oversized pool directly dilutes incoming investors. The Trap: 15%-20% is cited in the workbook as an extreme example, not the ideal range. 1%-3% and 25%-30% fall outside the source-stated 5%-10% band. Note: The workbook frames option pools as a dilution mechanism within the capitalisation table; the 5%-10% band is the only quantitative guidance given.
